subject: Clearview trial: success checklist, ops owners & kickoff date
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearview-analytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@clearview-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the demo today — the team found the latency profile and cost modeling very helpful. As discussed, we'd like to formalize success criteria for a 4-week trial so our engineering and procurement teams can sign off. To make sure we're aligned, here's what we need from Redwood to validate fit: 

- Latency: p95 end-to-end inference latency (including our network) under 200 ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens); p95 under 400 ms for long prompts (~1k tokens).
- Throughput: sustained 50 rps (concurrent users modeled as bursts with 95th percentile traffic).
- Cost: target token cost below $0.001/token or equivalent per-request cost that keeps our monthly forecast under $7k.
- Quality: factual accuracy >= 92% on our 200-sample eval set; hallucination rate < 3% measured by our validation rubric.
- Instrumentation: access to per-request logs, p95/p99 latency by route, token counts, and audit logs for the trial period.

Kickoff: we'd like to start the week of Dec 6 if possible. Can you confirm Redwood owners, measurement methods, and what artifacts you'll provide (sample workload runner, dashboards, and a short SOC2 evidence note)?

Thanks — I'll loop in our infra lead if you need extra details.

Best,
Liam
Senior Product Manager
Clearview Analytics

-----Original Message-----
On Mon, 2026-11-22 at 07:45 Evelyn Hart wrote:
> Great talking today — attached a rough scope for the POC.

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call

Hi Liam,

Appreciate the clear list — this is very helpful. Confirming we can run a 4-week evaluation with the targets you listed as the primary acceptance criteria. High-level plan and owners below: 

- Redwood owners: Evelyn Hart (AE, overall champion), Marcus Lin (Lead SE — benchmark & test harness), CS instrumentation (ops handoff once POC starts).
- Measurement plan: Marcus will deliver a reproducible load script and measurement notebook; we will measure p50/p95/p99 latency at the API edge (including network from our hosted region) and provide per-request token accounting.
- Quality eval: we'll run your 200-sample eval set against the pinned model; results will be reported as precision/recall and a short error taxonomy.
- Security/compliance: we will provide SOC2 scoping notes and an example of audit logs; full SOC2 artifacts will follow the enterprise pack if you proceed beyond trial.

Attachments: clearview-poc-scope.xlsx (scope & timeline), sample-workload.txt (simple loader template).

Next steps: 
1) Can you confirm the Dec 6 kickoff?
2) Please share the 200-sample eval set and any scoring rubric (CSV preferred).
3) Marcus will propose a concrete benchmarking window and initial config (batching, KV cache warmup plan) by EOD Nov 23.

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff + ops sync once we have the sample set.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearview-analytics.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@clearview-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call

Thanks — adding the technical plan below. Quoting Liam's asks for visibility.

> - Latency: p95 end-to-end inference latency (including our network) under 200 ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens); p95 under 400 ms for long prompts (~1k tokens).
> - Throughput: sustained 50 rps...

Technical approach (short):
- Test harness: we'll provide a k6-based script that replays your sample workload with configurable concurrency and arrival patterns.
- Measurement windows: run a warmup (5 min), single-run baseline (15 min), then a sustained 1-hour soak at target load to capture steady-state p95/p99.
- KV cache warmup: for chat/streaming scenarios we'll document cache priming steps; initial runs should include a cold and warm comparison.
- Batching: we'll test with continuous batching off (latency-sensitive) and a conservative batching profile (max batch 8 with 20 ms window) to see cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Metrics we will capture: per-request latency (client and server timestamps), token count, model variant, batch size, GPU utilization, and error codes.

Benchmark config we'll propose by EOD Nov 23: region (us-west-2), model pin (open-model-v2-8b-fp16), sequence-length buckets (short/medium/long), and synthetic arrival distributions.

I'll also include a short-run script to compute your quality metrics (compare generated answers to the gold set and flag hallucinations using your rubric).

— Marcus
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@clearview-analytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearview-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T07:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call

Thanks Marcus — this looks good. A couple of asks from our side before kickoff: 

- Security checkpoint: our security team needs a short note on how logs are redacted (PII) and retention controls during the trial. Can you provide the SOC2 scoping note and confirm whether logs can be exported to our S3?
- Audit logs: we will need per-request audit logs (timestamp, request id, model id, token counts) for the trial period.
- Model pinning & fallback: we want to pin the model for the POC but allow an automatic fallback to a smaller-quantized variant only if latency SLOs are missed — please document the fallback behavior.
- Kickoff: Dec 7 (Tuesday) works better for our team — can you confirm Redwood availability and a 30-min sync at 10:00 PT?

If you can share the load script and an exportable results dashboard (CSV or Drive) before the kickoff, that will help our infra team validate test runs quickly.

Regards,
Sana
Infra Lead | Clearview Analytics
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@clearview-analytics.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearview-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call

Perfect — thanks for the clarifications. Quick confirmations and action items: 

- Kickoff: Dec 7 at 10:00 PT confirmed. I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda (kickoff, measurement plan, security Q&A, next steps).
- Security: we'll attach the SOC2 scoping note to the Drive folder and confirm S3 export options; logs can be redacted and exported — I'll send the redaction policy doc prior to kickoff.
- Model pin/fallback: Marcus will document the fallback policy (pin by model id, fallback to quantized-variant only with explicit policy and monitoring).
- Deliverables before kickoff (Nov 30): k6 load script, sample-run CSV template, a short README for cache-warmup and batching knobs, initial benchmark config.

Related links: HubSpot deal, shared Drive folder, and the POC agreement (DocuSign) are in the metadata for this thread.

Action owners: 
- Evelyn: schedule kickoff + HubSpot update
- Marcus: deliver load script & benchmark config (by Nov 30)
- Clearview (Liam/Sana): share 200-sample eval set + rubric (by Nov 30)

Looking forward — we'll aim to have the initial run and dashboard ready within 48 hours of kickoff so you can validate signal quickly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
